title: Optimizing Legacy Infrastructure Migration
business: Enterprises managing large-scale, heterogeneous on-premises server environments that need to transition to Google Cloud.
problem: Organizations often struggle with visibility into their existing infrastructure, leading to inaccurate capacity planning, over-provisioning of cloud resources, and unpredictable migration timelines.
solution: Google Cloud Migration Center provides a centralized platform to perform automated discovery, detailed assessment, and structured planning, enabling data-driven migration recommendations based on actual workload utilization.
steps: Deploy discovery collectors to the on-premises environment to gather inventory and performance metrics.
Import asset data into the Migration Center to create a comprehensive view of the server landscape.
Analyze resource utilization patterns to generate right-sized cloud infrastructure recommendations.
Group assets into migration waves based on dependencies and business priority.
Execute the migration plan using the generated insights to ensure optimal target configurations.
outcome: A streamlined, predictable migration path that minimizes over-provisioning and reduces the risk of performance bottlenecks in the target cloud environment.
limitation: The accuracy of migration recommendations is strictly dependent on the quality and duration of the data collected; short collection windows may fail to capture peak utilization periods, requiring manual validation.
